WorkflowEmailAddress.description: An email address, or one merge field that holds one.

anyOf.description: Text, which may hold merge fields. One merge field alone, such as "{{contact.custom.utm_source}}", copies that field into this one, keeping its type; when the field copied from is empty, this one is left as it is. Text with merge fields mixed in is filled in as a message is, and must fit the field: a number field needs it to come out as a number, a date field as a date, a choice field as one of its choices.

Text, which may hold merge fields. One merge field alone, such as "{{contact.custom.utm_source}}", copies that field into this one, keeping its type; when the field copied from is empty, this one is left as it is. Text with merge fields mixed in is filled in as a message is, and must fit the field: a number field needs it to come out as a number, a date field as a date, a choice field as one of its choices.

onlyIfEmpty.description: true: write only when the field has nothing in it; a field that has a value is left alone, and the step says so. Left out or false: the value is replaced.

oneOf.description: The moment the step runs. A date field takes today's date in the automation's time zone (settings.timezone); a date and time field takes the instant. Only for date and date-and-time fields.

field.description: The date field to count from, such as contact.custom.event_date. Not together with value.

value.description: A fixed date to count from (2026-12-01, or a date and time with its offset), or "now". Not together with field. With neither, it counts from now.

days.description: How many days to add; a negative number goes back.

oneOf.description: A date moved by a number of days: from a date field, from a fixed date, or from now. { "op": "date_add", "days": 365 } is a year from today. Only for date and date-and-time fields. A field with no date in it fails the step.

anyOf.description: A field by its path, such as contact.services or deal.value.

left.description: A number, or a number field by its path, such as contact.custom.budget, read when the step runs.

anyOf.description: A field by its path, such as contact.services or deal.value.

right.description: A number, or a number field by its path, such as contact.custom.budget, read when the step runs.

oneOf.description: Arithmetic on two numbers: left operator right, such as { "op": "math", "left": "contact.custom.visits", "operator": "+", "right": 1 }. Only for number fields. A field that holds no number, and a division by zero, fail the step.

start.description: A 24-hour time of day, such as 09:30.

end.description: A 24-hour time of day, such as 09:30.
